sentences: Across ten joined panels, a towering bookcase unfolds compartment by compartment.

Twenty-seven of its thirty-five shelves hold stacks of books, and between them sit prized objects: bronze incense burners, crackle-glazed stoneware, Yixing teapots, seals, and a plate of narcissus and citrons.
Chaekgado means 'picture of bookshelves', a genre that spread in the late 1700s after King Jeongjo, a devoted book collector, kept such screens beside his throne.
Its painters borrowed European shading and perspective so the shelves seem to stand inside the room.
A tiny seal hidden in one panel identified the artist as Yi Taek-gyun, a leading court painter of the later 1800s.
The Cleveland Museum of Art acquired the screen in 2011, and it is one of only three works by him known to survive.
